verdict.rationale: Microsoft Entra's Conditional Access documentation describes if-then policies that gate access to specific apps (e.g., requiring MFA for Microsoft 365) and lets admins configure Conditional Access per application. Device identities explicitly enable device-based Conditional Access policies. A community report that actor tokens bypass Conditional Access is a narrow exception, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: evidence of network/IP and location-based conditions, risk-signal (sign-in/user risk) driven policies, group-scoped policy targeting, and independent hands-on corroboration.
